findings.title: Off-by-one page slice returns one extra item
findings.claim: slice(start, start + size + 1) returns size + 1 items, so every page leaks the first item of the next page.

findings.title: Missing await before reading the rotated token
findings.claim: store.save is not awaited, so store.get can return the previous token and the caller receives a stale value.

findings.title: Batch errors are swallowed in runAll
findings.claim: The catch block in runAll ignores the failure and returns an empty result instead of propagating the error.

findings.title: Negative page numbers are not clamped
findings.claim: pageNumber is multiplied by size without clamping, so a negative page produces a slice counted from the end of the array.

verdicts.reason: The slice end bound is start + size + 1, so the returned page has one more element than requested.
The save call is not awaited before the read, so the returned token can be stale on a slow store.
The catch block logs and then rethrows the same error at line 6; the error is not swallowed and callers still receive it.
